decision.analyst: O7 I161L is bright (3.687) while O1 shows I161L in a multi-edit context also bright (4.029); O8 V163A:I136L is 3.629. Conservative C-class proxies for these positions are I161V, V163A, Y106F, N164S, N170S.
decision.hypothesis: Conservative class-matched edits at positions 161/163 (I161V, V163A) plus Y106F and N164S/N170S retain or improve brightness relative to C-menu baselines (~3.5-3.6), whereas non-conservative destabilizing edits (L7P, H77P, I167N) drop sharply.
decision.critic: C39/C38/C24 predictions cluster tightly (3.53-3.56) with low uncertainty; C30 and C15 are lower with higher uncertainty, so no design strongly exceeds baselines.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize low-uncertainty conservative edits at 161/163/106/170/164 (C39,C38,C24); then test I161V/I171V contrast (C15) and multi-edit C30 to probe context effects.
